profile.headline: Engineer & Curious Mind | Passionate About Game Boy Mods, Car Mechanics, and Building Innovative Solutions
profile.summary:
I’m an engineer driven by curiosity and a love for building and optimizing systems, whether it’s crafting cutting-edge tech solutions or restoring retro Game Boys. With a professional background in software engineering, I specialize in designing APIs, creating developer tools, and even experimenting with mobile game development.

Beyond the screen, I channel my passion into hands-on projects like Game Boy mods and car mechanics, exploring how things work and pushing boundaries to make them better. This curiosity fuels my work in tech, where I combine analytical thinking with creative problem-solving to tackle complex challenges.

Here’s what I bring to the table:

- A strong foundation in building scalable APIs and developer tools to enhance workflows.
- Experience creating innovative systems and platforms for fintech, AdTech, and growth focused products.
- A passion for exploring creative avenues like mobile game development and automation.

When I’m not coding, you can find me working on restoration projects, sharing my creations on YouTube, or learning something new. I thrive in roles that allow me to create, innovate, and learn alongside great teams.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Defined and implemented code standards to ensure consistency and quality across all projects.
- Developed and deployed autopilots to automate ad optimization processes, resulting in increased efficiency and effectiveness.
- Collaborated on the setup and integration of an AI agent, enhancing the company's capabilities in AI-driven solutions.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Worked in a variety of banking features for customers, including checking, savings, and investment options.
- Specialized in the integration of a roboadvisor provider functionalities for investment and retirement accounts.
- Played a role in the internationalization of the platform, ensuring a seamless experience for users across different regions.
- Contributed to the rebranding of the app to align with the new company, Oportun.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Growth Acquisitions Engineer:

- Developed and managed landing pages, blogs, referral programs, and other marketing initiatives to drive customer acquisition and engagement.
- Collaborated with the marketing team to optimize content and campaigns for better performance and reach.

Product Engineer:

- Transitioned to a product engineering role, focusing on enhancing product functionality and user experience.
- Developed and implemented QR code menus for restaurants during the COVID-19 pandemic, providing a contactless solution for customers.
- Integrated with delivery partners such as DoorDash and Uber Eats, expanding the reach and convenience of Square's offerings for restaurant clients.

positions.title: Technical Marketing Engineer
positions.description:
- Supported the marketing team by developing and implementing automation tools to enhance their efficiency and success.
- Designed and implemented solutions to improve the code quality of the application, ensuring robust and maintainable software.
- Served as the open source "ballast," advocating for and integrating open source solutions within the company.
- Built micro applications related to marketing tooling and the main blogging platforms for the company using the latest technologies.

positions.title: Software Development Team Lead
positions.description: Reviewing current systems, presenting ideas for system improvements, working closely with analysts, designers and staff, testing the product in controlled, real situations before going live and maintaining the applications core code.

positions.title: Front End Developer
positions.description: Invigos is an online platform to teach children how to write. My responsibility was to develop the front end part of the application. The technology includes, real time updates, a customized editor and a lot of sharing elements between the students and teachers.

positions.title: Team Leader
positions.description: I was the responsible of managing the core development team for the company. We implemented SCRUM for the first time in the company and developed all the applications that are used as the SAAS platform for the clients. I was able to implement the framework for the development of the applications and design (UI and backend), program, maintain and improve this platform over the years. We used ExtJS for the UI, CakePHP and Java for the backend.

positions.title: Software Developer Intern
positions.locationName: 2da. Av. de Campo Alegre  con Libertador  Torre Cari, PH2  Campo Alegre Caracas
positions.description: Responsible for maintaining the current application called RISE and develop a prototype for a standalone version of the platform. The online (main) project was developed using asp .NET and C# with a database in MySQL.

projects.title: Pancho and Quelito's Night of Dread
projects.description: Our 48 hour's project for the 2014 Global Game Jam. Pancho and Quelito's Night of Dread A platform/puzzle/suspense videogame, about a little kid named Pancho and his loyal buddy Quelito trying to escape from the darkness that haunts them before Pancho´s lantern runs out. Solve the different puzzles to escape while using their unique abilities to help each other.

projects.title: Contact Manager
projects.description: Application to handle the subscriptor list for the marketing campaigns with filtering, importing, exporting and easily displaying the information for that subscriptor. Has a public API for developers to integrate to the platform. Was developed using Java EE and with Sencha Extjs.
